reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding; functions are also exported Server Actions). No trust_assumptions in scope file (Gate 2). src/app/actions.ts and src/app/api/ are explicitly in scope and admin role enforcement is listed as a key concern (Gate 3). An attacker can trigger this via any authenticated session by invoking the forceToggleAttendance(targetUserId) Server Action directly, causing forged attendance records to be inserted for arbitrary users without any admin role check. Additionally, forceLogoutAll is callable without authentication via GET /api/admin/force-logout-all during JST 22:50-23:50, causing bulk forced-logout of all checked-in members. Severity upgraded from MEDIUM to HIGH: multiple admin-only operations (forceToggleAttendance, createTeam, deleteTeam, updateTeam) are accessible to any authenticated user, constituting a broken access control vulnerability with direct data integrity and availability impact on the core attendance system.
